briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P -0.1%), a neutral session with no clear directional catalyst. With $989 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into three fully-confirmed momentum setups (DHT, KSS, CNR) rather than letting capital sit idle, per the risk-rule preference to fill open slots when cash exceeds $500. Existing positions are held unchanged since none hit stop-loss or profit-target levels.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strong recent performance tends to continue in the near term. Today's buys were selected because they showed multiple confirming technical signals together — not just one indicator — which reduces the chance of chasing a false signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，理論依據是近期表現強勢的股票短期內往往會延續漲勢。今日的買入標的是因為同時出現多個技術指標確認訊號，而非僅依賴單一指標，這樣可以降低誤判假訊號的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a market in consolidation mode after recent moves. Sector-level divergence was visible, with some retail and shipping names showing volume-backed breakouts even as the broader averages stayed flat. This kind of quiet, mixed tape is typical between larger macro data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤呈現窄幅震盪格局，沒有單一明顯的消息面催化劑，顯示大盤正處於近期漲勢後的整理階段。個股層面出現分歧，部分零售與航運類股在成交量放大的支撐下出現突破走勢，儘管主要指數維持平盤。這種淡靜、分歧的盤面在重大宏觀數據或財報公布之間相當常見。

trades.reasoning: Full five-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) makes this the top-scored candidate.
